name: Misli
note: Not rated yet: Misli's owners are not identified. Demirören Holding's site says only that Misli received an investment from it in 2019, and Futbol Medya (January 2019) reported the group was bidding for misli.com; no source gives Misli Elektronik's shareholders, so a Turkish state or state-fund link (control, 5% or more along the chain, or a board seat) can't be ruled out. Turkey has a record in this data (turkey-kavala-detention). Misli sells the Spor Toto Organization's fixed-odds betting as a licensed electronic dealer (a contract with a state body, not ownership). Official betting and right-sleeve sponsor of Galatasaray for 2025-26 through 2027-28.
